question: Should ClawHub take ownership of a server-hosted, cross-device feed-watch and notification inbox now, rather than continue with the client-first watch rollout?
rationale: The decision determines whether ClawHub accepts durable account ACL, privacy, retention, fanout, abuse, and installed-inventory-consent responsibilities; implementation quality cannot resolve that product and operational boundary.

options.title: Keep it parked
options.body: Retain this draft as a design prototype until client-side watches establish demand and the prerequisites named in the PR body are available.

options.title: Sponsor a reduced server scope
options.body: Approve a narrowly defined account-hosted capability and request a rebased, scoped follow-up with explicit privacy, retention, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Adopt the full inbox direction
options.body: Accept ClawHub ownership of the server-hosted watch and inbox model, then assign area owners for API, privacy, and operational responsibilities.

recommendation.title: Keep it parked
recommendation.body: Retain this draft as a design prototype until client-side watches establish demand and the prerequisites named in the PR body are available.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies the prototype author and its explicit pending ownership conditions, though a current-main product owner should be designated by maintainers.
